study: Tier-2 float dynamic range and wider fixed-point characterization

dynamic_range_method.min_max: exact over every full float array at every executed iteration
dynamic_range_method.percentiles: estimated by deterministic sampled panels and 0.05-decade log histogram

scaling_part_c.reason: No single static power-of-two scale is numerically viable: fitting the measured p99.99 message tails into 14 signed bits requires shifts that quantize every 4.58--8.52 physical prior to zero. A dynamic shared-exponent/block-floating scheme would be a new stateful architecture, not the requested simple normalization, so it was not introduced without a separate characterization design.
